acceptanceMatrix.criterion: the preferred provider is not assembled from another provider's parts
acceptanceMatrix.expected: the configured DeepSeek route survives with its own key, protocol and providerId
acceptanceMatrix.actual: apiKey=deepseek-real-key, protocol=openai, providerId=7; leads the chain
acceptanceMatrix.before: apiKey=gemini-key, protocol=gemini, and the configured row was dropped by the slug claim

acceptanceMatrix.criterion: no route is invented for a provider with no key
acceptanceMatrix.expected: no openrouter route; gemini still reachable
acceptanceMatrix.before: slug=openrouter carrying the Gemini key — a guaranteed 401 charged to the wrong provider

acceptanceMatrix.criterion: a gateway may offer more than one model
acceptanceMatrix.expected: both configured OpenRouter rows survive, in priority order
acceptanceMatrix.before: ['model-a'] — the configured fallback was silently dropped

acceptanceMatrix.criterion: a provider is not asked for another vendor's model
acceptanceMatrix.expected: a Groq route does not request gemini-3.1-flash-lite
acceptanceMatrix.actual: Groq route carries the Groq per-plan default
acceptanceMatrix.before: the first attempt of every classification asked Groq for a Gemini model

acceptanceMatrix.criterion: an unrecognised model name is not overridden
acceptanceMatrix.expected: the operator's configured model passes through

acceptanceMatrix.criterion: a response whose body never arrives is abandoned
acceptanceMatrix.expected: rejects inside the timeout
acceptanceMatrix.before: await res.json() waited unbounded; the timer had been cleared when the headers arrived

acceptanceMatrix.criterion: the chain stops when the trip budget is spent
acceptanceMatrix.expected: well under the sum of the per-route timeouts

acceptanceMatrix.criterion: a route that cannot finish in the remaining budget is not started
acceptanceMatrix.expected: fewer attempts than routes

acceptanceMatrix.criterion: a broad outage does not re-try every dead provider on every request
acceptanceMatrix.expected: at most one probe

acceptanceMatrix.criterion: a healthy provider is preferred over an open one
acceptanceMatrix.expected: the open route is not called at all
acceptanceMatrix.actual: no call to the open route

acceptanceMatrix.criterion: an open route is still probed when it is the only one
acceptanceMatrix.expected: one attempt, then LlmChainError
acceptanceMatrix.note: refusing outright would turn a degraded provider into a permanent outage

acceptanceMatrix.criterion: reading the breaker state does not consume the probe
acceptanceMatrix.expected: repeated circuitSnapshot() leaves the failure count unchanged
acceptanceMatrix.actual: unchanged across 4 reads past the cooldown
acceptanceMatrix.before: each read decremented the count; a dashboard refresh granted a free attempt

acceptanceMatrix.criterion: health is per route, not per provider name
acceptanceMatrix.expected: a 401 on one model does not condemn a sibling model

acceptanceMatrix.criterion: Retry-After is recorded and honoured
acceptanceMatrix.expected: retryAfterMs on the attempt; a 600s Retry-After keeps the breaker open past the 60s default
acceptanceMatrix.actual: retryAfterMs=120000 recorded; still open at +120s after a 600s header

acceptanceMatrix.criterion: a length-truncated reply fails over instead of being parsed
acceptanceMatrix.expected: failure kind 'truncated', answer from the next provider
acceptanceMatrix.before: transport 200 was reported as success and the caller parsed a severed object

acceptanceMatrix.criterion: thinking is disabled in each provider's own dialect
acceptanceMatrix.expected: DeepSeek receives thinking:{type:'disabled'}; NVIDIA receives chat_template_kwargs
acceptanceMatrix.actual: as expected; no flag at all for a non-reasoning model
acceptanceMatrix.before: the vLLM extension was sent to DeepSeek, ignored, and the model spent its budget reasoning

acceptanceMatrix.criterion: every attempt reports what it spent
acceptanceMatrix.expected: a failed first attempt's 90 prompt tokens are counted
acceptanceMatrix.before: only the winning call was visible; failovers were billed as free

acceptanceMatrix.criterion: cached prompt tokens are reported separately
acceptanceMatrix.expected: cachedTokens on the response and the attempt

acceptanceMatrix.criterion: per-plan voice limits are read per plan
acceptanceMatrix.actual: as expected, plus a free-row fallback for an unknown plan and a non-numeric setting
acceptanceMatrix.before: parseVoiceExpense read voice_limit_free for every plan

acceptanceMatrix.criterion: the duration is measured, not accepted
acceptanceMatrix.expected: a claim of 0 on real audio still charges seconds
acceptanceMatrix.actual: floor derived from payload size at 8KB/s; a 600s clip claiming 0 is refused on the per-request limit

acceptanceMatrix.criterion: the monthly balance is actually compared
acceptanceMatrix.expected: refuse when spent, and when this recording would overrun the remainder
acceptanceMatrix.actual: monthly_limit_reached and monthly_limit_exceeded, with the remainder named in the message
acceptanceMatrix.before: usedSeconds was computed and never compared on parseVoiceExpense

acceptanceMatrix.criterion: content type and size are enforced
acceptanceMatrix.expected: 6 accepted types, 5 rejected; size measured on the payload not the data: header

acceptanceMatrix.criterion: the budget is reserved before the network call
acceptanceMatrix.expected: assertAiBudget precedes runSTTPipeline on both endpoints
acceptanceMatrix.actual: both endpoints call the shared gate then assertAiBudget, then transcribe
acceptanceMatrix.before: parseVoiceExpense asserted the budget after STT had been paid for
acceptanceMatrix.note: verified by reading the call order; not exercised end-to-end without a database

acceptanceMatrix.criterion: the cache key names the thresholds
acceptanceMatrix.expected: an auto-save threshold change is not served from a result computed under the old one
acceptanceMatrix.actual: strict and lenient settings produce different decisions for the same sentence
acceptanceMatrix.before: a settings change took effect only after the 7-day TTL expired

acceptanceMatrix.criterion: the cache key names the model and the business
acceptanceMatrix.expected: a model switch misses; two businesses stay apart

acceptanceMatrix.criterion: an identical request still hits (positive control)
acceptanceMatrix.expected: second call served from cache with the same items

acceptanceMatrix.criterion: a cache hit spends nothing
acceptanceMatrix.expected: tokensUsed 0, the saving visible as cachedTokens
acceptanceMatrix.before: the stored token count was re-billed on every hit

regressionFoundAndFixedDuringA2.symptom: 5 tests failed after the cache key gained a version prefix (classification-cache-invalidation, learning-loop)
regressionFoundAndFixedDuringA2.cause: invalidateUserClassificationCache matched `cls:${userType}:${userId}:` while the key had become `cls:${version}:${userType}:...`; a user correcting a category kept being served the answer they had just corrected
regressionFoundAndFixedDuringA2.fix: one shared `tenantScope()` helper called by both the key builder and the invalidator
regressionFoundAndFixedDuringA2.note: the same class of defect this whole round is about — two places deriving one string independently
